results.title: How US-China tech rivalry has been reset by Jensen Huang saga
results.description: Laila Khawaja is research director at Gavekal Technologies, the financial services and analytics firm’s tech wing. Before her current role, she worked at Gavekal Fathom China from its founding in 2009, developing broad expertise in China’s corporate landscape. A graduate of Beijing Foreign Studies University and Harvard University, she is currently based in Miami. In this interview, Khawaja discusses the whirlwind dismissal and restoration of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, how that saga and other...
